item.text:
Implemented in `app/ContactForm.tsx`.

### What changed
- Added an inline server action `submitContactMessage` in `app/ContactForm.tsx:2` using `'use server'`.
- Added server-side JavaScript validation to ensure `name`, `email`, and `message` are all present and non-empty (`app/ContactForm.tsx:9`).
- Throws an error if any field is missing (`app/ContactForm.tsx:17`).
- Added the contact form UI with:
  - Name input (`app/ContactForm.tsx:37`)
  - Email input (`app/ContactForm.tsx:42`)
  - Message textarea (`app/ContactForm.tsx:47`)
  - Submit button (`app/ContactForm.tsx:50`)
- Wired the form to the inline server action via `action={submitContactMessage}` (`app/ContactForm.tsx:34`).

### Validation behavior
On submit, the server action checks all three fields and rejects the submission if any are blank.
